savings.reason: Full EO:13385 actor context read: §§3/9 revoke the relevant orders without any express saving of their commands; other continuation and amendment provisions concern named other committees. Preexisting statutory/agency authorities and accrued consequences are not continuing independent duties created by these orders. This finding concerns residual operation after formal revocation and does not decide the missing earlier first-end chronology.

research_rationale: Full original, own terms, actor contexts, chain, searches and missing list read. EO:13326 §§1-4 establish the Commission and its mission/administration. §5 is a final-report deadline calculated from the first meeting, not a termination. §6(b) is submission-triggered and says within 60 days, so even knowledge of the report date would establish only an outer limit without actual termination evidence. EO:13385 §3(b), ACT:EO:13326>EO:13385 chars 3778-4194, revokes an already terminated/completed committee order; §10, effective#0 chars 9663-9712, makes that formal revocation effective 2005-09-30. It does not exclude an earlier first end. The affirmative missing EO:13349 lead cannot be dismissed without its absent provision. No date is invented, no report deadline is converted to an end, and no formal revocation is used as the first end merely to pass the gate. Local draft only, pending full GitHub freeze; unable to accept for review on current dossier.
unresolved_material_gaps: ORIGINAL:EO:13326 §6(b), chars 5181-5266, makes Commission termination occur within 60 days after actual final-report submission. The dossier contains no report-transmission date or actual termination instrument/date; §5 deadline (chars 4618-4780) is not evidence of actual submission or an end. EO:13385 §3 acknowledges committees already terminated or completed and cannot establish the earliest end.

Dossier missing list affirmatively flags target provision not located: EO:13349. No EO:13349 text/context is held in this dossier, so its possible alteration of reporting or termination terms cannot be resolved.
